decisions.reason: The code change modifies the loop condition from `i < values.length` to `i <= values.length`. This causes the loop to execute one additional iteration where `i` equals `values.length`. Accessing `values[i]` at this index throws an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`, which is a repeatable crash. The severity is correctly classified as HIGH.
